records.translation: 对于 :data:`FAST_PANELS` 中列出的图表，:func:`render_panel` 会直接导出所提供的 ``FastPlot``，使保存的图表与可见的标签页一致。在 ``auto`` 模式下，若调用时没有活动的控件，则使用相应的 matplotlib 面板。``SPACR_FIGURE_RENDERER=pyqtgraph`` 显式要求根据系数表构建新场景；``matplotlib`` 则强制使用该渲染器。

records.source: The control guides are used first, because the spread of guides that target nothing is the null distribution. On the reference screen the two agree closely (0.83 against 0.84), but a strong signal raises the all-guide MAD while the control MAD is unchanged.
records.translation: 优先使用对照向导序列，因为不靶向任何基因的向导序列的离散程度就是零分布。当有限对照少于 :data:`MIN_CONTROLS` 个，或对照离散程度为零时，改用所有有限系数的 MAD。在参考筛选中两者非常接近（0.83 对 0.84），但强信号会抬高全部向导序列的 MAD，而对照的 MAD 保持不变。

records.context: **Assumption tests have their own power.** With n = 3, Levene's test has almost no power, so "p = 0.7" means the variances could not be compared, not that they are equal. Using that result to select Student's t can report a difference that is not there. Below :data:`MIN_N_FOR_ASSUMPTIONS` this module records both checks as uninformative, treats the data as not normal, and selects a rank test (Mann-Whitney U, Wilcoxon signed-rank when paired, or Kruskal-Wallis for more than two groups). This loses some power when the assumptions hold and avoids false positives when they do not.
records.label: spacr.figures.stats#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Assumption tests have their own power.** With n = 3, Levene's test has almost no power, so "p = 0.7" means the variances could not be compared, not that they are equal. Using that result to select Student's t can report a difference that is not there. Below :data:`MIN_N_FOR_ASSUMPTIONS` this module records both checks as uninformative, treats the data as not normal, and selects a rank test (Mann-Whitney U, Wilcoxon signed-rank when paired, or Kruskal-Wallis for more than two groups). This loses some power when the assumptions hold and avoids false positives when they do not.
records.translation: **假设检验本身也有检验效能。** 当 n = 3 时，Levene 检验几乎没有检验效能，因此 "p = 0.7" 表示无法比较方差，而不是方差相等。据此选择 Student's t 可能会报告并不存在的差异。低于 :data:`MIN_N_FOR_ASSUMPTIONS` 时，本模块将两项检查都记录为无信息量，把数据视为非正态，并选择秩检验（Mann-Whitney U；配对时用 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验；多于两组时用 Kruskal-Wallis）。当假设成立时，这会损失一些检验效能；当假设不成立时，则可避免假阳性。

records.context: **Unit of replication.** spaCR measures thousands of cells across a handful of microplate sample positions. Testing across cells when the replicate is the microplate sample position is pseudoreplication and can return p < 1e-10 on pure noise, because n is inflated about a thousandfold. Every result states what n counted, and :func:`compare` takes a ``unit`` so a caller can aggregate first.
records.label: spacr.figures.stats#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Unit of replication.** spaCR measures thousands of cells across a handful of wells. Testing across cells when the replicate is the well is pseudoreplication and can return p < 1e-10 on pure noise, because n is inflated about a thousandfold. Every result states what n counted, and :func:`compare` takes a ``unit`` so a caller can aggregate first.
records.translation: **重复单位。** spaCR 在少数几个孔中测量数千个细胞。当重复单位是孔时，跨细胞进行检验属于伪重复，即使对纯噪声也可能得到 p < 1e-10，因为 n 被放大了约一千倍。每个结果都会说明 n 统计的是什么，:func:`compare` 接受 ``unit`` 参数，以便调用方先进行汇总。

records.context: This is the only module in spaCR that selects a test. :mod:`spacr.sp_stats` previously selected its own and disagreed with this one on three of five inputs, each time choosing the parametric branch where the checks lacked power. It is now a translation layer onto :func:`compare`, :func:`check_normality` and :func:`check_equal_variance` that keeps its older signatures and result keys. Change the choices here and both entry points move together; ``tests/test_one_engine_decides_which_test_applies.py`` fails if they ever come apart again.
records.label: spacr.figures.stats#7
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: This is the only module in spaCR that selects a test. :mod:`spacr.sp_stats` previously selected its own and disagreed with this one on three of five inputs, each time choosing the parametric branch where the checks lacked power. It is now a translation layer onto :func:`compare`, :func:`check_normality` and :func:`check_equal_variance` that keeps its older signatures and result keys. Change the choices here and both entry points move together; ``tests/test_one_engine_decides_which_test_applies.py`` fails if they ever come apart again.
records.translation: 这是 spaCR 中唯一负责选择检验的模块。:mod:`spacr.sp_stats` 以前有自己的选择逻辑，在五个输入中有三个与本模块不一致，每次都在检查缺乏检验效能时选择了参数检验分支。它现在是对 :func:`compare`、:func:`check_normality` 和 :func:`check_equal_variance` 的转换层，保留了其旧的函数签名和结果键。在此修改选择规则，两个入口会同步变化；如果两者再次出现分歧，``tests/test_one_engine_decides_which_test_applies.py`` 会失败。

A labels mask may be at full resolution while a downsampled preview is not; a points layer of centroids is in continuous coordinates and has no grid at all; and confocal z-stacks in this codebase are routinely anisotropic — 0.65 µm in x and y, 2 µm in z is an ordinary spaCR stack.

records.source: Layers do not agree on pixels. A labels mask may be at full resolution while a downsampled preview is not; a points layer of centroids is in continuous coordinates and has no grid at all; and confocal z-stacks in this codebase are routinely anisotropic — 0.65 µm in x and y, 2 µm in z is an ordinary spaCR stack.
records.translation: 各图层的像素并不一致。标签掩膜可能是全分辨率的，而降采样的预览则不是；由质心构成的点图层使用连续坐标，根本没有网格；而且本代码库中的共聚焦 z 堆栈通常是各向异性的——x 和 y 方向 0.65 µm、z 方向 2 µm 就是一个普通的 spaCR 堆栈。

records.context: So a layer never says "row 40, column 12". It says "this data axis is *z*, one step along it is 2 µm, and element 0 sits at 0 µm" — a :class:`Spacing` — and everything downstream happens in world units. A :class:`Canvas` is a window onto that world (an origin, a step and a size, over two named world axes), and rendering is: for every canvas pixel, ask each layer what is at that world coordinate.
records.label: spacr.layers#9
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: So a layer never says "row 40, column 12". It says "this data axis is *z*, one step along it is 2 µm, and element 0 sits at 0 µm" — a :class:`Spacing` — and everything downstream happens in world units. A :class:`Canvas` is a window onto that world (an origin, a step and a size, over two named world axes), and rendering is: for every canvas pixel, ask each layer what is at that world coordinate.
records.translation: 因此，图层从不说 "row 40, column 12"（第 40 行第 12 列）。它说的是“这个数据轴是 *z*，沿它前进一步是 2 µm，元素 0 位于 0 µm 处”——即一个 :class:`Spacing`——下游的一切都以世界单位进行。:class:`Canvas` 是通向这个世界的一扇窗口（在两个具名世界轴上，由原点、步长和尺寸构成），而渲染过程就是：对画布上的每个像素，询问每个图层在该世界坐标处有什么。

records.context: Five modes, all of which honour ``opacity`` the same way — ``alpha = coverage * opacity`` — except :data:`OPAQUE`, which first sets every non-zero coverage to 1, so a soft-edged layer fully covers the layers below it wherever it has any coverage. Opacity still scales an opaque layer; "opaque" describes what it does to the layers below it where it *has* something, not whether it can be faded.

records.source: Five modes, all of which honour ``opacity`` the same way — ``alpha = coverage * opacity`` — except :data:`OPAQUE`, which first sets every non-zero coverage to 1, so a soft-edged layer fully covers the layers below it wherever it has any coverage. Opacity still scales an opaque layer; "opaque" describes what it does to the layers below it where it *has* something, not whether it can be faded.
records.translation: 五种模式都以相同方式遵循 ``opacity``——``alpha = coverage * opacity``——只有 :data:`OPAQUE` 例外，它会先将所有非零覆盖度设为 1，因此边缘柔和的图层在其有覆盖的任何位置都会完全遮住下方的图层。不透明度仍会缩放不透明图层；"opaque"（不透明）描述的是该图层在*有*内容之处对下方图层的作用，而不是它能否被淡化。

records.translation: 三个推论：

records.context: **This module never deletes anything.** There is no call to ``deleteObjects`` in it, under any mode, for any object. If a previous ``APPEND`` run left three copies, ``REPLACE`` updates the oldest and *reports* the rest in :attr:`AnnotationResult.duplicates` — removing them is a decision for a human with the OMERO.web UI, not for an importer.
records.label: spacr.omero#27
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **This module never deletes anything.** There is no call to ``deleteObjects`` in it, under any mode, for any object. If a previous ``APPEND`` run left three copies, ``REPLACE`` updates the oldest and *reports* the rest in :attr:`AnnotationResult.duplicates` — removing them is a decision for a human with the OMERO.web UI, not for an importer.
records.translation: **本模块从不删除任何内容。** 其中没有对 ``deleteObjects`` 的调用，无论哪种模式、针对哪种对象。如果之前的 ``APPEND`` 运行留下了三份副本，``REPLACE`` 会更新最早的一份，并在 :attr:`AnnotationResult.duplicates` 中*报告*其余副本——是否删除它们应由人通过 OMERO.web UI 决定，而不是由导入程序决定。

records.context: **FileAnnotations always append.** The bytes of an OriginalFile cannot be rewritten in place through the gateway, and the alternative — delete the old attachment — is exactly the destructive behaviour ruled out above. records.source: **FileAnnotations always append.** The bytes of an OriginalFile cannot be rewritten in place through the gateway, and the alternative — delete the old attachment — is exactly the destructive behaviour ruled out above. The namespace plus the timestamp in the description identify the newest.
records.translation: **FileAnnotation 始终追加。** OriginalFile 的字节无法通过网关就地重写，而另一种做法——删除旧附件——正是上文所排除的破坏性行为。命名空间加上描述中的时间戳可以标识最新的一份。

records.context: **TagAnnotations are never edited.** In OMERO a tag is a *shared* object; renaming the tag linked to this image renames it on every other object in the group that carries it. So :func:`export_tag_annotation` links a tag when the verdict is new, does nothing when the identical verdict is already linked, and reports the previous tag when the verdict has *changed* — it never unlinks and never renames.
records.label: spacr.omero#29

records.source: **TagAnnotations are never edited.** In OMERO a tag is a *shared* object; renaming the tag linked to this image renames it on every other object in the group that carries it. So :func:`export_tag_annotation` links a tag when the verdict is new, does nothing when the identical verdict is already linked, and reports the previous tag when the verdict has *changed* — it never unlinks and never renames.
records.translation: **TagAnnotation 从不编辑。** 在 OMERO 中，标签是*共享*对象；重命名与此图像关联的标签，会使组内所有带有该标签的其他对象上的标签一并改名。因此，:func:`export_tag_annotation` 在判定结果是新的时关联一个标签，在已关联完全相同的判定时不做任何操作，在判定*发生变化*时报告先前的标签——它从不解除关联，也从不重命名。

records.source: That is :func:`spacr.convert.target_name` verbatim — the exact shape ``spacr.utils._get_regex('cellvoyager', 'tif')`` parses — so the output folder is handed straight to Mask/Measure with ``metadata_type='cellvoyager'`` and nothing else. **No new layout is invented here.** The one thing that must survive the trip is the plate geometry, because spaCR keys every measurement, every plot and every well-level statistic off ``plateID`` / ``rowID`` / ``columnID`` / ``fieldID``; :func:`well_position` is where OMERO's 0-based ``(row, column)`` becomes spaCR's ``('r1', 'c1')`` and the well name ``A01``.
records.translation: 这完全就是 :func:`spacr.convert.target_name`——正是 ``spacr.utils._get_regex('cellvoyager', 'tif')`` 所解析的确切格式——因此输出文件夹可以直接交给 Mask/Measure，只需 ``metadata_type='cellvoyager'``，无需其他设置。**这里没有发明任何新布局。** 转换过程中唯一必须保留的是板的几何结构，因为 spaCR 以 ``plateID`` / ``rowID`` / ``columnID`` / ``fieldID`` 作为每个测量值、每张图和每个孔水平统计量的键；:func:`well_position` 负责将 OMERO 从 0 开始的 ``(row, column)`` 转换为 spaCR 的 ``('r1', 'c1')`` 以及孔名 ``A01``。

records.context: Everything that is easy to get wrong here is *arithmetic and string formatting*, not RPC: the row/column mapping, the filename, the id parsing, the float formatting, the decision to replace rather than append. All of it lives in pure functions over plain data — :func:`well_position`, :func:`plane_filename`, :func:`parse_object_ref`, :func:`format_map_value`, :func:`measurement_pairs`, :func:`plan_annotation` — and the ``BlitzGateway`` calls are confined to a thin layer that only walks containers and moves bytes. This module is therefore tested on a machine with no OMERO server and no ``omero-py`` installed: the fake gateway in ``tests/test_omero.py`` implements about a dozen methods, and everything worth testing is reachable through it.
records.label: spacr.omero#7
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Everything that is easy to get wrong here is *arithmetic and string formatting*, not RPC: the row/column mapping, the filename, the id parsing, the float formatting, the decision to replace rather than append. All of it lives in pure functions over plain data — :func:`well_position`, :func:`plane_filename`, :func:`parse_object_ref`, :func:`format_map_value`, :func:`measurement_pairs`, :func:`plan_annotation` — and the ``BlitzGateway`` calls are confined to a thin layer that only walks containers and moves bytes. This module is therefore tested on a machine with no OMERO server and no ``omero-py`` installed: the fake gateway in ``tests/test_omero.py`` implements about a dozen methods, and everything worth testing is reachable through it.
records.translation: 这里所有容易出错的地方都是*算术和字符串格式化*，而不是 RPC：行/列映射、文件名、id 解析、浮点数格式化，以及选择替换而不是追加的决定。所有这些都实现为作用于普通数据的纯函数——:func:`well_position`、:func:`plane_filename`、:func:`parse_object_ref`、:func:`format_map_value`、:func:`measurement_pairs`、:func:`plan_annotation`——而 ``BlitzGateway`` 调用则局限于一个只负责遍历容器和传输字节的薄层。因此，本模块可以在既没有 OMERO 服务器、也没有安装 ``omero-py`` 的机器上进行测试：``tests/test_omero.py`` 中的模拟网关实现了大约十几个方法，所有值得测试的内容都可以通过它访问。

records.translation: 对每个数值列，在该列确实有值的行上取均值，并附加 ``n_objects``。缺失值会*从其所在列的均值计算中排除*，而不是填充为零：在 spaCR 中，NaN 通常是结构性的（对于没有病原体的细胞，``pathogen_*`` 列为 NaN），而填充为零会把 "no pathogen"（无病原体）变成“大小为零的病原体”。在任何行中都没有可用值的列报告为 ``None``，:func:`measurement_pairs` 会将其渲染为 ``NaN``。
